_README.what: Props are in-world documents you can open. An item record says a ledger exists; a prop lets the reader read it. Rendered by renderProp() in index.html, styled by app/styles/systems/exhibits.css.
where_they_appear: Inline in any prose field, via the marker [[prop:<id>|visible text]] — becomes a clickable .proplink.
As a tile grid on the item page of every item listed in the prop's `items` array.
As an 'Exhibits' card at the foot of any article listed in the prop's `articles` array.
_README.adding_one: Add an object here, give it `kind`, `title`, `body` (HTML using the .pd-* classes) and at least one link in `items` or `articles`. No JS or CSS changes are needed. Keep the body factual to the source record — a prop is evidence, not new canon.
_README.stamps: Optional. `stamps: ["overdue"]` renders .pd-stamp--overdue. Available: overdue, paid, void, sealed, noaction, evidence.

prop_ebot_correction_demand.title: Correction Demand — Sheet 41
prop_ebot_correction_demand.subtitle: Filed 1032 BF · acknowledged by a clerk · never answered
prop_ebot_correction_demand.note: The demand was posted, acknowledged, and never acted upon. The Company later burned down with its plates inside, which is why Survey Series IV can no longer be corrected by anybody at any price.
prop_ebot_correction_demand.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Office of the Auditor-General
To
The Works Manager, The Old World Mapping Company
Re
Survey Series IV, Sheet 41 — defective plate
Dated
19 Aethel, 1032 BF

Sir,

Your Sheet 41 names the mountain at the head of the Northern Reach MOUNT EBOT. The mountain is correctly Mount Ebot. The mountain your customers believe they are buying is Mount Ebott, which lies four hundred miles east of it, and which contains a barrier, a quantity of monsters, and a king with a beard.

Your cartouche offers corrections on application. This is the application.

On the seventeenth of this month a party of three reached the summit of your Sheet 41 on the strength of your spelling. A chartered aircraft was destroyed. A twenty-two-year-old man was opened above the eye by a thrown bone and dressed under an overhang in hail. He was promised nothing and has so far received it.

Waluigi does not ask for damages. Waluigi asks for a T.

Correct the plate. Reissue the sheet. Every copy still folded in a saddlebag is a hazard you engraved.

Waluigi
Auditor-General
 
For the Company — no reply received
Acknowledged by a clerk, 24 Aethel 1032. Nothing further. Works destroyed by fire; plates lost. — filed to archive 1040 BF

prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.title: Truth Ledger — Sworn Statements and Contradictions
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.subtitle: Maintained by Orvinder Danos, barrister · double-column form
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.note: It does not force truth magically in public records. Everyone around it simply behaves as though lying near it would be personally embarrassing.
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.body:
Orvinder Danos, Barrister
Ledger of Sworn Statements · Contradictions Marked
DeponentSwornLater established
Witness AWas not present at the hour statedWas present; corrected on the second reading
Witness BNever handled the instrumentHandled it twice, both times gloved
Witness CCannot recall the sumRecalled the sum exactly when it was read back wrong
Witness DStatement withdrawn before entryWithdrawn; retained here because a withdrawal is also evidence
1. A statement entered in this ledger is entered in the deponent's own words and read back to the deponent before signature.
2. A contradiction is recorded in the right-hand column without comment. The column is not an accusation. The column is a column.
3. Nothing in this ledger protects the practitioner against a technically truthful evasion, and the practitioner should stop expecting it to.
O. Danos
Keeper of the ledger
A truth ledger is only as good as the person willing to read the ugly line twice. — W.

prop_rakka_silence_contract.title: Terms of Engagement — Silence Protocol
prop_rakka_silence_contract.subtitle: Employer copy · clause 7 is the one that matters
prop_rakka_silence_contract.note: Inferred from Rakka-related teleportation and silence references. If your employer has a silence protocol, your retirement plan is probably a shovel.
prop_rakka_silence_contract.body:
Terms of Engagement
Employer Copy · Not For Issue To The Engaged Party
Engaging party
Rakka
Engaged party
____________________ (completed on acceptance)
Term
Until concluded
1. The engaged party performs the work described and does not describe the work performed.
2. Payment is rendered on completion. Completion is determined by the engaging party.
4. Knowledge acquired incidentally in the course of the work remains the property of the engaging party.
6. The engaged party shall not be told the identity of other engaged parties, and shall not enquire.

This document is retained by the engaging party. No counterpart is issued. The absence of a counterpart is itself a term.

prop_ironhand_order_120.title: Order 120 — Quarantine of the North
prop_ironhand_order_120.subtitle: Signed by General Ironhand · tribunal exhibit
prop_ironhand_order_120.note: Ironhand chose to commit his atrocity to text, and text testifies. Some weapons have blades. This one has a nib and a body count.
prop_ironhand_order_120.body:
Restricted — Command Distribution Only
Iron Legion · Command
Standing Order Number 120
Issued by
General Ironhand, commanding
Occasion
Breach of Aegis Command; Planar Fracture at Raventree Manor
Effect
Legion Wall Checkpoint constituted a sealed quarantine
Distribution
Garrison commanders. Not for posting.
I. The northern line is closed. No writ, no passage, no exception granted at garrison level.
II. Travel writs are inspected at the checkpoint. Non-compliant operatives are detained, not turned back.
III. Detainee populations exceeding the capacity of the holding facility are to be reduced.

Ironhand
General, commanding
 
Countersignature — none required
Paragraph IV is four lines long and did not require him to raise his voice. That is the case. — W.

prop_bloomia_rose_letter.title: The Winter Rose Letter
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.subtitle: Left by Bloomia · survival-coded · authenticates the witness
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.note: The message pointing toward the place where roses grow in winter. A flower clue is still a knife if the right people fear it.
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.body:
No letterhead · no direction · no signature

If this reaches the right hands it will mean nothing to the wrong ones, and that is the whole of my hope.

Ask for the place where roses grow in winter. Do not ask a lord. Ask someone who carries things and is not looked at.

The one who greets you there will not use my name. If they say the roses were planted for a wedding that did not happen, that is the sign, and you may say anything after it.

I am well. That is also a code, and I am sorry for it.

🌹
Unsigned — a drawn rose in place of a name
She wrote a location into a garden and trusted a servant over a court. Both decisions were correct. — W.

prop_xo_stage_card.title: Stage Direction Card — Act Two
prop_xo_stage_card.subtitle: From X.O.'s deck · an operation written as a performance
prop_xo_stage_card.note: A god complex with cue cards is still a god complex. The cards are filed because the aesthetics are operational: when the staging is offended, the cruelty goes up.
prop_xo_stage_card.body:
ACT TWO

ENTRANCE. Not through the door. Through the door is what they are watching.

LIGHT. Behind. Always behind. A face explained is a face diminished.

THE LINE. Delivered once. If it must be repeated the scene has already failed and the failure is theirs.

THE FACE. Selected for the audience, not for the crime. Choose the one they will remember in the retelling.

IF INTERRUPTED. The interruption becomes the scene. Nothing is a mistake if it is committed to.

— CURTAIN HELD UNTIL THEY UNDERSTAND —

Read it twice. The fourth line selects a victim by how well they will describe the event afterwards. That is not vanity. That is target selection. — W.

Charcoal on paper · scale unrecorded
Outer ring
Binding notation. Repeated without variation, which in ward-work means closed.
Middle ring
A dedication. Names the thing sealed, not the reader.
Inner mark

prop_toad_lee_diary_page.title: Diary Page — Lady Aurelian, on Grafting
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.subtitle: Preserved by Toad Lee, who read the plot
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.note: Toad Lee fell out a window, yes. He also read the important thing. Both facts can coexist, and only one of them is in this file.
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.body:
Diary of Lady Aurelian · loose page, preserved

They call it grafting, which is a gardener's word, and they chose it on purpose. A graft takes. A graft is not a wound, it is a joining, and the tree does not complain afterwards because the tree has nothing left to complain with.

What is joined is not the flesh. Anyone can join flesh. What is joined is the line — and a line that has been joined once can be joined again, which is the part they do not say aloud at the table.

The Legion watches the wrong end of it. They watch the bodies. The bodies are the least interesting part. Watch the blood-work, and watch who is keeping the record of it, because whoever keeps that record decides afterwards what happened.

A.
Unsigned beyond the initial
Reading is a combat skill. This page connects Legion observation to Corvinarus blood-work and it was recovered by the party member most famous for a window. — W.

prop_tea_syndicate_page.title: The Third Steeping — House Doctrine
prop_tea_syndicate_page.subtitle: A page from the Tea Leaf Syndicate book · read by Eager, absorbed by nobody
prop_tea_syndicate_page.note: Tea people made hot leaf water into doctrine. Waluigi is annoyed and impressed, in that order, and only just.
prop_tea_syndicate_page.body:
The Tea Leaf Syndicate
On the Third Steeping · House Doctrine, Article the Ninth
i. The first steeping is for the guest. It is courteous, it is weak, and it tells you nothing.
ii. The second steeping is for the table. By it a house is judged, and by it a house intends to be judged, which is why the second steeping is never the truth.
iii. The third steeping is for the business. It is taken after the guest has said the thing they came to say and before they have decided whether they meant it.
iv. A leaf held too long turns bitter and cannot be made sweet again by any subsequent kindness. The Syndicate applies this to leaves and to people and considers the comparison exact.
v. Serve the third steeping yourself. A cup poured by a servant is a cup poured by whoever pays the servant.
Preparations not found in polite markets are treated in Articles the Eleventh through Fourteenth, which are not reproduced here and which the archive has not seen.
Clause v is genuine operational security dressed as etiquette. Eager read this page and learned nothing, which is also data. — W.

prop_black_crystal_carrier_order.title: Carrier Discipline Order — Portal Artifact Set
prop_black_crystal_carrier_order.subtitle: Issued to the party. Not to be read aloud in corridors.
prop_black_crystal_carrier_order.note: Written after Lyranth demanded the crystal from Eager, who did not have it and could not have produced it.
prop_black_crystal_carrier_order.body:
Party Eyes Only — Do Not CopyParty Eyes Only — Do Not Copy
Disaster Inc. · Archive
Standing Order on Carriage of the Portal Set
Subject
Black Crystal (anchor key)
Public-known carrier
Markop
Actual carrier
Not recorded here. That is the point.
Occasioned by
Lyranth’s demand upon Eager, who was carrying nothing
I. The enemy has established that the crystal matters. The enemy has not established who is carrying it. Those are two different disasters and only one of them has happened.
II. Eager was named as carrier by Lyranth and was not the carrier. This error is the single most valuable asset the party currently owns. Do not correct it. Do not correct it accidentally, either, which is harder.
III. The public-known holder is Markop. Markop is instructed to be visibly, tediously careful with a pocket, and to keep being careful with that pocket long after it stops being interesting.
IV. No member of this party is to say the words “who has the crystal” in a room with a door in it.
Waluigi
Chief Archivist
Markop
Named holder, publicly
Filed with the Black Crystal record. If you are reading this and you are not in the party, the archive would like to know how, and so would several other people.

prop_necromancer_wand_demand.title: Letter of Demand — Surrender of a Death-Aspected Focus
prop_necromancer_wand_demand.subtitle: The Mages Guild, to a person they had not previously had occasion to write to.
prop_necromancer_wand_demand.note: Addressed to Bowser. There is no record of a reply, and the wand has not moved.
prop_necromancer_wand_demand.body:
The Mages Guild
Office of Restricted Foci · correspondence

To the King of the Koopas, wherever this finds him,

It has come to the Guild’s attention that an object dropped by the claimant Vivian during the corridor engagement at the Shadow Estate — a focus of death aspect, cold to the touch, of a make the Guild recognises and does not admire — was subsequently retrieved from the floor by yourself.

The Guild does not suggest that you took it improperly. The Guild observes only that it was on the floor and you are, by all accounts, a person who picks things up.

Such foci are corruptive by design. They reward curiosity and they punish it in the same motion. The Guild would ordinarily write at length here about the risk to the bearer’s mind, and has prepared four paragraphs to that effect, which have been struck at the request of a colleague who has met you.

We ask that the focus be surrendered to any Guild station. We do not ask that it be studied, demonstrated, pointed at anyone, used to settle an argument, or kept because it is interesting.

Awaiting your reply, without confidence,

Keeper of Restricted Foci
The Mages Guild
No reply was sent. Waluigi suspects the wand is more disturbed by Bowser than Bowser is by the wand, and that this is the safest containment the Guild will ever achieve by accident. — W.

prop_lyranth_commission_card.title: Commission Card — Finishing Works, Figures in Stone
prop_lyranth_commission_card.subtitle: A card of terms, of the kind an artisan hands to a patron. Read the third term.
prop_lyranth_commission_card.note: The chisels are ordinary. The card is what makes them an exhibit.
prop_lyranth_commission_card.body:
Lyranth · Sculptor
Card of terms for commissioned finishing works
Medium
Stone. Supplied by the commission.
Tools
Fine chisels, the artisan’s own
Turnaround
Prompt. The medium does not improve with waiting.
I. The artisan undertakes finishing work only. The artisan does not supply the figure. The commission supplies the figure.
II. Expression is at the artisan’s discretion. Patrons who request a particular expression will be accommodated where the figure permits it.
III. The artisan works most successfully within the first hours. After that the surface hardens through and the fine detail — the mouth especially — can no longer be improved.
IV. Composition is not negotiable. A figure placed badly is a figure wasted, and the artisan will not have work of hers stood in a corridor facing a wall.
Lyranth
Sculptor
 
Commission (unsigned)
Term III is a working window. Read it again knowing that. It says the tools work best while the stone is new, and stone is not new unless something was recently not stone. — W.
The archive files this under art tools and would like it noted that it did so with a straight face and considerable difficulty.

prop_ebot_addendum_1040.title: Addendum — Sheet 41, on Release
prop_ebot_addendum_1040.subtitle: Filed 1040 BF · eight years after the mountain · attached to a demand nobody can answer
prop_ebot_addendum_1040.note: Waluigi could not get the plate corrected, so Waluigi published the day instead. This is the slip that turned a failed complaint into an archive filing.
prop_ebot_addendum_1040.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Office of the Auditor-General · addendum to file
Attached 1040 BF — eight years after the ascent of 17 Aethel, 1032
Attached to
Correction Demand — Survey Series IV, Sheet 41
Status of demand
Filed. Acknowledged by a clerk. Unanswered.
Respondent
The Old World Mapping Company — no longer exists

The demand above was filed and is still, at the date of this release, unanswered. The company that could have answered it no longer exists. A correction requires somebody to correct it, and there is nobody left at that address to receive a letter, let alone a plate.

Waluigi has therefore done the only remaining useful thing and published the day itself:

i. the bridge is armed;
ii. the sentry does not speak;
iii. the slope returns its dead;
iv. and four humans are named on a plank past the span, with the fourth name rubbed nearly out.

None of that has aged. A mountain does not care which year you reach it in.

Eight years. The T is still missing. Waluigi has stopped asking and started printing.
WAH.

prop_neighbor_addendum_third_telling.title: Addendum — Wario's Final Comment
prop_neighbor_addendum_third_telling.subtitle: The third telling · in the Feywild · while trying to sell garlic
prop_neighbor_addendum_third_telling.note: Wario withheld the only important detail across two full interviews. Asked why, he said: 'You didn't ask.' Waluigi filed the addendum and declined to comment further.
prop_neighbor_addendum_third_telling.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Addendum to file · account of Wario · third telling
Recorded after the file was closed — the account was already published
Source
Wario, verbally, unprompted
Circumstances
Feywild. Mid-transaction. Attempting to sell garlic.
Tellings prior
Two — this detail appeared in neither

Waluigi records the following for completeness, though it is probably not significant.

The neighbor left in a hurry, right? Like someone called him. And when I was leaving the basement, I saw his desk upstairs — the one near the front door. There was a communicator on it. Still active. Still connected. And there was a voice coming through it. Faint. But I heard it.

Waluigi asked what the voice said.

It said, "Professor, it's happening again. He's emerged. We need the contingency." And then it said a name.

Waluigi asked what name.

It said "Mr. L."

Wario paused.

And then it said: "Activate Protocol Green Thunder."

Waluigi asked Wario why he had not mentioned this in the previous two tellings. Wario shrugged and said: "You didn't ask."

Waluigi has no additional commentary on this addendum. Waluigi is not going to think about it. Waluigi is moving on.
WAH.

prop_archie_dream_addendum.title: Addendum — Why This Dream Belongs in the Main Chronicle
prop_archie_dream_addendum.subtitle: Filing-classification note · dream evidence, contested
prop_archie_dream_addendum.note: A ruling on where a dream is filed. Waluigi refuses the footnote on the grounds that the dream contains too many live campaign objects to be decorative.
prop_archie_dream_addendum.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Classification ruling · main chronicle vs. footnote
Attached after filing — the placement was challenged and the challenge failed

A lesser historian would place this in a footnote and call it psychological color. Waluigi is not a lesser historian.

Objects appearing in the dream that are live files elsewhere in this archive:

ObjectAlso filed under
Star ShardsArtifacts — active recovery
Star CoreArtifacts — hesitation on record
Frog GodDivine consequence — the abandoned Toad
EagerHostage leverage — ongoing
HjumpikTrust imagery
Original DanPersonal consequence — entanglement
The VigilanceAirship — burning, in the dream
The Dreadful GroveLocation — storm magic

If a dream contains that many active files, it is no longer color. It is a filing cabinet on fire.

The dream also connects two kinds of consequence. The Frog God is the cosmic result of Archie abandoning the Toad. Original Dan is the personal result of Archie being tangled in another person's destruction. The dream forces Archie to face both, then wakes him where the current party crisis continues. That is structure. Cruel structure, but structure.

Standing recommendation
1. Archie should tell someone immediately — not later, not after three jokes and one accidental tactical disaster.
2. Told, the dream becomes shared preparation.
3. Kept private, it remains the Frog God's rehearsal room inside his skull — and privacy lets shame edit the useful parts.
Waluigi prefers enemy rehearsals to be interrupted.
WAH.

prop_feyward_addendum_legible.title: Addendum — Why This Session Matters More Than It Looks
prop_feyward_addendum_legible.subtitle: Feyward branch · nothing solved, everything made legible
prop_feyward_addendum_legible.note: Waluigi's argument that an unsolved problem you can finally see is worth more than a solved one. Filed under: Feyward Complications, Toad Lee Suspicion, Morel Key, Steely Loss, Revel Still Ongoing.
prop_feyward_addendum_legible.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Addendum · Feyward branch assessment
Attached to the session record — the session did not close the branch

Waluigi wants to be clear that this session did not resolve the Feyward branch. It made the Feyward branch more legible. That is different and, in some ways, more useful.

A solved problem stops moving. A legible problem can be hunted.

SubjectBefore the sessionAfter
Toad LeeUseful, occasionally ridiculousUseful, ridiculous, and a possible security problem
Mystic MorelAmbiguous presenceAntagonist and informant — appeared from a wall, survived near-decapitation, issued a targeted warning, provided a key
SteelyPresentLost. Deserves, if not XP, at least a record.
The revelOngoingStill ongoing

Money is not the only thing characters carry. They carry obligations. They carry evidence. They carry debts that never entered a ledger because the person who issued them smiled instead of writing them down.

Waluigi will track both, because Waluigi knows that unrecorded debts are how people end up dancing forever.
WAH.
